While Dext excels at receipt and expense scanning, Lightyear provides complete AP automation with purchase order management, 3-way matching, and supplier controls — critical for hospitality and multi-site operations. Dext's lower price is compelling, but it lacks the controls that prevent overcharging and payment fraud.
